## LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.72 — real tables from `#table` zones

### Repaired
- **Word / EPUB / Excel export**: a zone marked `#table` now produces a real table. Until now the mark only changed how Tesseract reads the zone; the table itself was found only where the page showed wide gaps between columns, so a table of contents with dot leaders (`Metode biochimice ......51`) came out as flowing text.
- A contents page inside a `#table` zone becomes two columns, title | page: dot leaders are removed, a title that runs onto a second line stays in one cell, and a page number at the right edge is found even when OCR turned the leaders into stray letters. Any other `#table` zone is cut into rows and cells at wide gaps, rows padded to the same width. Words outside the zone are read as before; a zone with fewer than two rows or columns leaves its words as text.

Built and tested by the CI of this release.
